\begin{abstract}

Single-pass (\texttt{1x}) linear activation steering fails in multimodal Diffusion Transformers whenever a static text/vision conditioning matrix $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}} \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times D}$ is re-injected across every block and denoising iteration (\emph{the Frozen-Anchor Prompt Veto}): opposing baseline descriptors inside $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ re-assert themselves across all \texttt{50} joint audio-video blocks and veto rank-1 additions, whereas \texttt{2x} differential velocity guidance doubles compute and requires text rewrites. We show that conflict-free, \texttt{1.00x}-NFE creative steering inside MiniMax H3 (\texttt{5376}-D bidirectional \texttt{TokenRefiner}, \texttt{24 fps} video + \texttt{40 Hz} stereo audio single-stream DiT) is governed by three coupled mechanisms: \textbf{(1) Affine Prelude Transport} combining prompt-centered rank-$r$ baseline clearing $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$, soft-MaxSim target pushes $\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d$, and explicit multi-vector facet/vision routes; \textbf{(2) Causal 4D Depth \& Query Routing} isolating visual/material breakout in \texttt{blocks.20..29} (\texttt{1.52x} mean / \texttt{1.75x} peak DINOv3 face retention over \texttt{blocks.0..49}), a \texttt{10}-block audio emergence lag (\texttt{blocks.31..47}), terminal \texttt{block 49} consolidation, and compiler-safe single-pass \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} query slicing (\texttt{1.003x} base latency, \texttt{+0} \texttt{malloc\_graph\_breaks} across \texttt{4} backends, \texttt{YIN} $F_0 = -0.014\text{ st}$, \texttt{+1.06 dB} Mode 3 recovery); and \textbf{(3) Conflict-Free Compositional Algebra} addressing up to \texttt{42.4\%} cross-slider erasure and \texttt{50.9\%} shared live-action scaffolding via clamped union spectra ($\lambda_{\max} \le 1.0$), per-slider Retain-Orthogonal Subspaces (\texttt{ROS}), barrier-aware resolved-mask grouping, and a smooth conditioning-norm knee (\texttt{95.5 -> 98.5}) that eliminates \texttt{4.0 MP} diptych splits (\texttt{highlight\_clip 0.07255 -> 0.00790}). Across CPU bank/LOPO audits (\texttt{52} stems, \texttt{7} per-pair \texttt{.pt} banks) and GPU Stage 1--2 gates, we reconcile earlier reporting errata (\texttt{median cos(mu\_d, v\_1d) = 0.9935}), document an honest Regime B case study (\texttt{de\_llm\_slop}), falsify unsupervised \texttt{Path 1B} token routing (\texttt{< 1.1\%} MSE), and define open \texttt{[PHASE 2 GPU]} gates for \texttt{Path 1C} \texttt{ColQwen} Dual-Lock release and diverse \texttt{192f}/\texttt{243f} non-\texttt{noir} AV evaluation.

\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction: Frozen-Anchor Recurrence \& The Three-Pillar Thesis}

\subsection{Autoregressive Self-Steering vs. Prelude Input Injection}

In causal autoregressive language models, a weak rank-1 nudge $\mathbf{h}' = \mathbf{h} + s\hat{\mathbf{v}}_{\text{1D}}$ needs only to flip early discrete \emph{pivot tokens}; once sampled, those generated tokens append to the prefix and rewrite the KV cache to self-steer subsequent generation. Non-autoregressive Diffusion Transformers invert this causal topology. A \textbf{Prelude} encoder (\texttt{Qwen3-VL-32B} layers \texttt{0..49} + \texttt{condition\_proj} + 2-block bidirectional \texttt{TokenRefiner}) produces $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}} \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times 5376}$ \textbf{once} before step $k = 0$, and the iterative \textbf{Core} (\texttt{50} single-stream \texttt{MiniMaxH3Model} DiT blocks) re-attends the same $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ at every step $k = 0,\dots,K-1$.

When $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ encodes a lighting, palette, material, or acoustic prior contradicting a desired edit, rank-1 mean addition fails at \texttt{1x} NFE (\texttt{0/5} \texttt{noir} stills and \texttt{0/3} \texttt{192f} videos turn monochrome; \texttt{paper\_origami} deletes foreground subjects when forced upward), whereas \texttt{2x} CFG/edit guidance doubles DiT forward passes.

\subsection{Thesis and Tightened Contributions}

This work restricts all empirical claims strictly to verified MiniMax H3 video, audio-video, and single-frame DiT pipelines (\texttt{Table 1} checkpoints) and establishes four concrete contributions:

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Flagship Mechanistic \& Causal 4D DiT Routing (\S{}5):} Mapping \texttt{blocks.0..49} uncovers \texttt{blocks.20..29} as the spatial/material breakout band (\texttt{1.521x} mean / \texttt{1.754x} peak DINOv3 CLS retention vs. \texttt{blocks.0..49}), a \texttt{10}-block audio lag (\texttt{blocks.31..47}), and \texttt{block 49} sink behavior (\texttt{sol\_attn\_h3.py::SOL\_DENSE\_TAIL}). Promoting unified compiler-safe hooks (\texttt{steer\_attention\_hooks.py::H3SteerStepWorkspace}) delivers \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} voice protection at \texttt{1.003x} latency with \texttt{+0} added \texttt{malloc\_graph\_breaks}.
\item \textbf{Corrected Affine Prelude Transport \& Diagnostic Self-Correction (\S{}4):} We present our \texttt{Theorem 1} ridge split honestly as classical Principal Components Ridge Regression (\textbf{Lemma 1}, \texttt{5.862e-14}), whose scientific contribution was refuting the assumption that \texttt{M3} worked via Pole-B token transport (\texttt{97\%-99.6\%} was $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$). We fix post-RMS non-inversion ($\gamma \le 1$) and clamped union bounds in \textbf{Theorem 1} and pair \texttt{< 15 ms} Jacobian-lens introspection (\texttt{j\_lens.py::decode\_vector}) with balanced \textbf{Regime A vs. Regime B} diagnostics.
\item \textbf{Conflict-Free Multi-Slider Algebra (\S{}3, \S{}4, \S{}6.2):} Across \texttt{52} \texttt{\_\_fl2va\_\_} stems (\texttt{2,652} pairs), we quantify up to \texttt{42.4\%} cross-slider erasure, a \texttt{15.9\%} self-overlap trap, and \texttt{50.9\%} shared live-action scaffolding (\texttt{G = 0.1540} = \texttt{103.5x} random), proving on CPU why \texttt{Bus-Scoped drop\_look\_pc16} (\texttt{7.94x} look-audio overlap cut, \texttt{100\%} Look retention) beats naive global PC removal and verifying Stage 1+2 \texttt{peer\_ros} + \texttt{soft\_cap\_stacked\_rms} on \texttt{4.0 MP} stills.
\item \textbf{Honest Track 2 Push-Side Boundaries \& Dual-Lock Law (\S{}6.4, \S{}7):} Across \texttt{7} cached per-pair \texttt{.pt} banks, \texttt{35.2\%-48.6\%} of transition energy remains unexplained after \texttt{1D mu\_d + r=8 erasure}. We falsify unsupervised \texttt{Path 1B} token-role routing (\texttt{< 1.1\%} LOPO MSE gain from \texttt{TokenRefiner} stop-word bleed) and isolate the Dual-Lock boundary (\texttt{tags == 0} VLM tokens + 24-ch VAE latents across \texttt{[0, 0.33]}), charting \texttt{Path 1A} atomic sub-faders + \texttt{Path 1C} \texttt{ColQwen} visual patches for Phase 2.
\end{enumerate}


\section{Related Work (Prior Art \& Attribution)}

To situate this system accurately inside 2020--2026 representation engineering, we explicitly distinguish inherited linear/spectral operators from net-new joint AV routing:

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Affine Subspace Erasure \& Concept Editing (\texttt{ACE}, \texttt{LEACE}, \texttt{CURE}, \texttt{Safree}, \texttt{IPErase}, \texttt{Linear-AcT}, \texttt{RASteer}):} Iterative nullspace projection (\texttt{INLP}, \texttt{RLACE}) and closed-form oblique projection (\texttt{LEACE}) were unified with activation addition by \textbf{Affine Concept Editing (\texttt{ACE})}, alongside SVD spectral/null-space diffusion erasers (\textbf{\texttt{CURE}}, \textbf{\texttt{Safree}}, \textbf{\texttt{IPErase}}), optimal-transport \textbf{\texttt{Linear-AcT}} (ICLR 2026), and retain-aware \textbf{\texttt{RASteer}} (\texttt{ROS} + \texttt{OAC}, Oct 2026). Rather than re-deriving negative safety unlearning, our Prelude operator adapts affine clearing to \emph{positive, continuous creative conflict resolution} at \texttt{1.00x} NFE using prompt-local centering $\bar{\mathbf{h}}$, $[0,1]$ polarity clamping, and RMS-locked double-dissociation controls.
\item \textbf{Video, Audio, \& Step-Adaptive Steering (\texttt{MUTE}, \texttt{FADE}, \texttt{STAS}, \texttt{TADA!}, \texttt{DATE}, \texttt{Diffusion Steering Lens}):} Recent DiT steering methods target single modalities --- text K/V motion unlearning (\texttt{MUTE}), frame-aware reactivation resistance (\texttt{FADE}), massive activation steering (\texttt{STAS}), dynamic step gating (\texttt{DATE}), or audio-only control (\texttt{TADA!}). None examine joint single-stream \texttt{24 fps} video + \texttt{40 Hz} stereo audio block specialization or \texttt{1x} query-sliced modal isolation (\texttt{Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base}).
\item \textbf{Late-Interaction Retrieval \& Static Probes (\texttt{ColBERT}, \texttt{ColQwen}, \texttt{Ward Pooling}, \texttt{Model2Vec}, \texttt{Chain Lens}):} Asymmetric row-softmax aligns unequal-length spans (\texttt{erasure.mu\_d}, \texttt{tau = 0.15}), hierarchical Ward clustering exposes Pole-B facets (\texttt{Path 1A}), and regularized linear inversion (\texttt{j\_lens.py}) provides \texttt{< 15 ms} lexical X-ray visibility into truncated VLM + bidirectional refiner states.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Corrected \texttt{52}-Stem Bank Census, Scaffolding, \& Regimes A/B}

Auditing all \texttt{52} \texttt{\_\_fl2va\_\_} \texttt{.safetensors} stems (replacing v4's unfiltered \texttt{"28 / 38"} set-difference word metric) establishes four empirical laws:

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Narrow Cosine Between \texttt{mu\_d} and \texttt{v\_1d} (\texttt{median = 0.9935}):} Across \texttt{52} stems, \texttt{48 / 52} satisfy $\cos(\boldsymbol{\mu}_d, \mathbf{v}_{\text{1D}}) \ge 0.980$. Soft-MaxSim materially redirects only \texttt{4 / 52} length-asymmetric concepts (\texttt{film\_16mm\_1974\_neutral} \texttt{0.9479}, \texttt{film\_16mm\_1974} \texttt{0.9529}, \texttt{noir} \texttt{0.9702}, \texttt{de\_llm\_slop} \texttt{0.9719}) and acts elsewhere as a zero-cost refinement.
\item \textbf{Cross-Interference \& Self-Overlap (\texttt{2,652} Ordered Pairs):} Raw peer erasure $\|\mathbf{V}_r^{(j)} \hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(i)}\|_2^2$ reaches \texttt{0.4240} (\texttt{D}-weighted \texttt{0.3520}; \texttt{V\_r(noir)} hits \texttt{cyberpunk\_neon\_rain} at \texttt{0.3166}), while \textbf{self-overlap} $\|\mathbf{V}_r^{(i)} \hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(i)}\|_2^2$ averages \texttt{0.1593} (\texttt{max 0.3284}). Consequently, naive global \texttt{V\_r perp all mu\_d} loses \texttt{+34\%..+70\%} Pole-A erasure potency.
\item \textbf{\texttt{50.9\%} Shared Live-Action Scaffolding (\texttt{G = 0.1540} = \texttt{103.5x} Random):} Pairwise subspace alignment reaches \texttt{median cos(theta\_1) = 0.6691}, with \texttt{48.8\%} (\texttt{D}-weighted \texttt{49.6\%}) of \texttt{P\_k} energy sitting in bank \texttt{PC[0..15]}. Crucially, on held-out prompts, \texttt{64.2\%-69.1\%} of Look Regime A erasure energy (\texttt{noir}, \texttt{paper\_origami}, \texttt{claymation}) sits inside \texttt{PC[0..15]} (the natural live-action baseline they must clear), whereas \texttt{reverb\_cathedral} (\texttt{50.4\%-51.0\%}) and \texttt{chaos\_panic} (\texttt{59.2\%-59.8\%}) leak across buses --- requiring \textbf{bus-scoped \texttt{V\_r}}, never blind global \texttt{PC[0..15]} stripping.
\item \textbf{Regime A vs. Regime B \& Unexplained Push Residual:} Symmetric subtraction works on Regime A manifold replacements (\texttt{noir}, \texttt{claymation\_stopmotion}, \texttt{reverb\_cathedral}) but flattens both poles on Regime B directional nudges (\texttt{de\_llm\_slop}, \texttt{look\_amber\_candlelight}). On the push side across \texttt{7} \texttt{.pt} banks, \texttt{35.2\%-48.6\%} of transition energy remains unexplained after \texttt{1D mu\_d + r=8} clearing.
\end{enumerate}

\subsection{Design Eliminations \& Fixed-Prompt Bottleneck (\texttt{Proposition 1})}

Rather than inflating engineering rejections into impossibility theorems, \textbf{Table 2} summarizes the three structural constraints that eliminated alternative parameterizations:

Mean-pooled doubly-stochastic Sinkhorn OT & Column marginal $\mathbf{1}^\top \mathbf{T} = \frac{n_A}{n_B}\mathbf{1}^\top$ & Average displacement collapses identically to $\bar{\mathbf{B}}_p - \bar{\mathbf{A}}_p = \mathbf{v}_{\text{1D}}$ (\texttt{max\_err = 8.882e-16}), requiring unpooled or asymmetric weights. \\
Unsupervised sparse dictionary atoms ($K=16$) & Sample dilution $\mathbb{E}[\|S_k\|] \le N_A / K$ & Collapses per-atom covariance rank when $N_A < 2K$ (e.g., \texttt{watercolor\_wash} $N_A = 22 \implies 1.38$ tok/atom; \texttt{noir} \texttt{0/5} B\&W). \\

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Proposition 1 (Fixed-Prompt Cross-Modal Subspace Bottleneck on \texttt{<Picture 1>} Pairs; formerly Prop 4).} \emph{Encoding $N$ paired images $(\text{Pic}_{A,n}, \text{Pic}_{B,n})$ alongside a single constant prompt $P_0$ of $M_0$ tokens concentrates leading right singular directions $\mathbf{V}_r$ onto $P_0$'s lexical variance $\operatorname{span}(\bar{\mathbf{R}}_{P_0} - \mathbf{1}\boldsymbol{\mu}_A^\top)$ whenever cross-attentive perturbations $\|\boldsymbol{\Xi}_{A,n}\|_F$ are small relative to word variance, leaving unseen opposing prompt adjectives in $\ker(\mathbf{V}_r)$.} \emph{(Operational fix now shipped in \texttt{control\_vector\_nodes.py::make\_control\_vector\_from\_media\_pairs} via per-pair \texttt{scene\_prompts}.)}
\end{quote}
\subsection{Lemma 1 (PCRR Empirical Split) \& Theorem 1 (Clamped Compositional EQ)}

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Lemma 1 (Principal Components Ridge Regression Split Diagnostic).} \emph{Let $\mathbf{A}_c = \mathbf{U}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\mathbf{V}^\top$ denote the centered weighted \texttt{diff\_span} matrix with top-$r$ factors $(\mathbf{U}_r, \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_r, \mathbf{V}_r)$. Because $\mathbf{U}_r^\top \mathbf{A}_c = \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_r \mathbf{V}_r^\top$ exactly by orthogonal columns of $\mathbf{U}$, the \textbf{Principal Components Ridge (\texttt{PCRR})} estimator $\mathbf{W}_{\text{PCRR}} = \arg\min_{\operatorname{row}(\mathbf{W}) \subseteq \operatorname{row}(\mathbf{V}_r)} \|\mathbf{D}_c - \mathbf{A}_c \mathbf{W}\|_F^2 + \lambda\|\mathbf{W}\|_F^2$ splits for any $\mathbf{B}_c$ into:}
$$(\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{W}_{\text{PCRR}} \equiv (\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{V}_r^\top \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac{\sigma_i}{\sigma_i^2 + \lambda}\right)\mathbf{U}_r^\top \mathbf{B}_c \;-\; (\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{V}_r^\top \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac{\sigma_i^2}{\sigma_i^2 + \lambda}\right)\mathbf{V}_r.$$
\end{quote}
Verified to \texttt{5.862e-14} (\texttt{bench/verify\_pole\_a\_erasure.py}), Lemma 1 does \emph{not} require ColBERT; its value was falsifying \texttt{M3 = Pole-B transport} by proving \texttt{97\%-99.6\%} (\texttt{ratio 4.2x-10.3x}, \texttt{cos +0.9686..+0.9960}) was the $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$ term built solely from \texttt{a\_spans} (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::build\_pole\_a\_erasure}).

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Theorem 1 (Clamped Parametric EQ, Per-Slider \texttt{ROS}, \& Conditioning-Norm Safety; \texttt{control\_vectors.py::\_stacked\_erasure\_block\_shift64}).} \emph{For $K$ grouped active sliders on identical resolved token rows (\texttt{\_build\_steered\_context}), define per-slider Retain-Orthogonal Subspaces \texttt{ROS} projecting $\mathbf{V}_{r,j}, \mathbf{D}_j$ orthogonal to peer pushes $\{\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(k)} : k \ne j\}$ (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::orthogonalize\_erasure\_against\_holds}), stack $\mathbf{W}_j = \sqrt{\operatorname{clip}(\min(s_j,1)\mathbf{D}_j^{\text{ROS}}, 0, 1)}\mathbf{V}_{r,j}^{\text{ROS}}$, and eigendecompose with strictly clamped eigenvalues $\mathbf{d}_{\text{union}} = \operatorname{clip}(\sigma^2, 0, 1)$. Then:}
1. \textbf{Exact Zero-Point \& Polarity Symmetry:} $\Delta\mathbf{H}(0) = \mathbf{0}$; for $s_j \le 0$, erasure vanishes cleanly (\texttt{clip(s\_j, 0, 1) = 0}).
2. \textbf{Bounded Union Spectrum:} Every union projector eigenvalue satisfies $\lambda_{\max} \le 1.0$, eliminating \texttt{> 1.0} over-subtraction spikes; \texttt{r\_union = 16} (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::COMPOSED\_ERASURE\_MAX\_RANK}) spans two orthogonal rank-8 subspaces exactly ($K = 2$).
3. \textbf{Post-RMS Non-Inversion Condition:} On single-slider shifts, pre-normalization Pole-A scaling $1 - \operatorname{clip}(s,0,1)\beta_{\text{cap}}g_k \in (0, 1]$ holds post-normalization whenever the outer RMS rescale satisfies $\gamma = |s|\tau_{\text{rms}} / \operatorname{RMS}(\Delta) \le 1$.
4. \textbf{Zero Cross-Target Erasure (\texttt{One-Sided ROS = Two-Sided Equilibrium}):} For rank-1 peer boosts, per-slider \texttt{ROS} guarantees $\mathbf{V}_{\text{union},-k}\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(k)} = \mathbf{0}$ identically without an extra runtime pass.
5. \textbf{Smooth Conditioning-Norm Cliff Compression (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::soft\_cap\_stacked\_rms}):} Compressing combined shift RMS smoothly above \texttt{STACK\_SMOOTH\_KNEE\_NORM = 95.5} toward \texttt{STACK\_SMOOTH\_CEIL\_NORM = 98.5} prevents high-norm spatial diptych splits (\texttt{>= 133.4} RMS on \texttt{h3\_image}) while preserving lower-magnitude mixes.
\end{quote}

Residual-norm profiling across all \texttt{50} single-stream DiT blocks reveals structured modal specialization rather than uniform layer processing:
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{\texttt{blocks.0..19} (Layout \& Reference Identity):} Steered text perturbations in \texttt{0..19} induce \texttt{border\_lap = 69.31} (identical to base \texttt{69.39}) on \texttt{paper\_origami} \texttt{ref2va}, anchoring spatial layout and \texttt{<Picture 1>} facial geometry.

\item \textbf{Showcase B Boundary (\texttt{description\_only} + \texttt{ReleaseReferences(0.50)}):} Restricting \texttt{blocks.20..49} strictly to \texttt{description\_only} while holding \texttt{<Picture 1>} conservatively preserves photorealistic faces (fluffing hair on \texttt{felt\_muppet}, darkening awnings on \texttt{noir}) unless look/scene spans are targeted.

\section{Systems Boundaries, Limitations, \& Cross-Architecture Hypotheses}

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Hardware Execution Boundaries:} \texttt{FrozenVideoCache} skips \texttt{double\_block} hooks and requires explicit \texttt{Mode 0} separation (\texttt{control\_vector\_nodes.py::MiniMaxH3Steer}). For \texttt{1x Q\_vid[mask]} spatial portals (\texttt{>= 30\%} queries), dense \texttt{bf16} SDPA overhead competes directly against sparse \texttt{2x} \texttt{MiniMaxH3Sol}; Phase 2 benchmarks whether bleed and conditioning-sink online-softmax merges justify promoting \texttt{1x Q\_vid} beyond \texttt{\textasciitilde{}130-300}-row \texttt{Q\_aud} (\texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base}).
\item \textbf{Modality / Tool Frontier:} \texttt{1x} Multi-Vector Prelude Steering covers global/bus styles, materials, weather, kinematics, and \texttt{40 Hz} acoustics; \texttt{2x} \texttt{MiniMaxH3EditGuider} retains novel multi-entity attribute binding and \texttt{< 30\%} spatial portals; \texttt{1x} \texttt{MiniMaxH3PromptExpander} owns multi-shot scripting and upstream prose cleanup.
\item \textbf{Testable Cross-Architecture Hypotheses (Untested Here):} Extending Prelude--Core--Coda subspace clearing to \emph{Looped-DiT}, masked diffusion LMs (\emph{LLaDA}, \emph{Dream}), and recurrent-depth LLMs (\emph{Huginn}, \emph{Ouro}) remains an explicit cross-architecture hypothesis for future work (\texttt{Spec E} \texttt{Qwen-Image-2.1} deferred in Phase 2 due to its \texttt{Qwen3-VL-8B} / non-\texttt{TokenRefiner} stack).
\end{enumerate}
